name: Integral Orthogonality of Indicator Functions
description: Replaces the "intervals do not intersect" constraints with an equivalent $L_2$ norm condition on the sum of indicator (step) functions: $\int (\sum \phi_i)^2 = \sum p_{1,i}$. This mathematically enforces disjointness (since cross-terms must integrate to zero) without using the words "intersect", "disjoint", or "interval", defeating models that rely on geometric or scheduling keyword triggers. The Note explains the unsatisfiability using Cauchy-Schwarz, further masking the $L_1$ interval-packing shortcut.
